description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Controller::Error' which handles various error responses such as bad request, forbidden, internal server error, and not found within a web application. It extends a base controller and uses Moose for object orientation.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Error
classes.description: A controller class for handling error pages and responses in a web application, providing methods for bad request, forbidden, internal server error, and not found errors.

methods.name: bad_request
methods.description: Handles 400 Bad Request errors by setting response status and rendering an error template.

methods.name: forbidden
methods.description: Handles 403 Forbidden errors by setting response status and rendering an error template.

methods.name: internal_server_error
methods.description: Handles 500 Internal Server Error by conditionally detaching to a not_found action or setting cache headers.

methods.name: not_found
methods.description: Handles 404 Not Found errors by setting response status and rendering an error template.
